name: Joseph
description: Named among Judas Maccabeus's own brethren as a leader of one of his four bands, each of fifteen hundred men; later left by Maccabeus with Simon and Zaccheus to besiege two castles in Idumea. First Maccabees names Mattathias's five sons as Joannan, Simon, Judas, Eleazar and Jonathan, with no Joseph among them; this record follows Second Maccabees' own text rather than resolve the difference

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
